title: Five Box Office Wars That Will Define the Second Half of 2026
excerpt: From Emraan Hashmi vs Sunny Deol on Independence Day to Shah Rukh Khan vs the Maddock Horror Universe at Christmas, the release calendar is a battlefield.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Five major box office clashes are set for the second half of 2026.
  • Emraan Hashmi and Sunny Deol face off on Independence Day with *Awarapan 2* and *Batwara 1947*.
  • August features a three-way battle with *Toxic*, *Eetha*, and *Vvan* releasing close together.
  • December brings the highly anticipated *Avengers: Doomsday* vs *Dune: Part Three* showdown.
  • Shah Rukh Khan's *King* will compete against the horror-comedy *Shakti Shalini* on Christmas.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=kGxJ9A-gKGQ The first half of 2026 gave us *Border 2* shattering records and *Bhooth Bangla* proving horror-comedy is the genre that won't quit. But the real drama starts now. The second half of the year is lined up with five box office clashes so loaded with star power, franchise muscle, and sheer audacity that even the trade analysts are running out of predictions. Here's your guide to the five showdowns worth watching — on screen and in the numbers. ### Awarapan 2 vs Batwara 1947 — August 14 (Independence Day) This one comes with a history lesson. In 2007, **Emraan Hashmi**'s brooding romantic thriller *Awarapan* released the same weekend as **Sunny Deol**'s family sports drama *Apne*. Nearly two decades later, the same actors are back on the same weekend — August 14, 2026. ![Sunny Deol — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d9/Sunny_Paaji_2024.jpg) > **"That line — *"Dard se purana rishta hai mera"* — hit harder the second time around."** *Awarapan 2* brings Emraan back as Shivam Pandit, the character that turned him from a serial kisser into a legitimate dramatic actor. Directed by **Nitin Kakkar**, with **Disha Patani** and **Shabana Azmi** rounding out the cast, the teaser dropped on June 29 and sent the internet into a tailspin of nostalgia. That line — *"Dard se purana rishta hai mera"* — hit harder the second time around. On the other side is *Batwara 1947*, a large-scale partition drama reuniting Sunny Deol with director **Rajkumar Santoshi** — the partnership that gave us *Ghayal*, *Damini*, and *Ghatak*. **Aamir Khan** is producing. **Preity Zinta** co-stars. The Independence Day release corridor is custom-built for this kind of patriotic spectacle. The wildest detail? **Shabana Azmi** appears in *both* films. She's guaranteed a hit weekend either way. ### Toxic vs Eetha vs Vvan — August 26/28 It's not a clash. It's a free-for-all. **Yash**'s much-delayed *Toxic* arrives August 26, followed two days later by **Shraddha Kapoor**'s *Eetha* (produced by Dinesh Vijan) and **Sidharth Malhotra** and **Tamannaah Bhatia**'s *Vvan* (produced by Ektaa Kapoor) on August 28. *Toxic* is mounted on a massive scale and needs maximum screens to justify its ambition. But Shraddha Kapoor is the post-*Stree 2* box office queen, and anything touching the Maddock orbit carries genuine commercial muscle. Yash may be the bigger star, but he has the most to lose in this three-way split. ### Sardar 2 vs Demonte Colony 3 — September 10/11 ![Demonte Colony — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/9/98/Demonte_Colony.jpg) A Tamil showdown between two beloved franchises. **Karthi** leads the action-packed *Sardar 2*, while the horror franchise *Demonte Colony* returns for a third installment with the same chilling energy that made it a regional juggernaut. For South Indian cinema fans in the diaspora — and there are a lot of you — this is the September date to block.

### Avengers: Doomsday vs Dune: Part Three — December 18 The global event of the year. Marvel's return to form with *Avengers: Doomsday* goes head-to-head with Denis Villeneuve's *Dune: Part Three* on the same December weekend. Both franchises command massive loyalty in India — and here's the twist that's making Hollywood nervous: due to an exclusive IMAX deal with the *Dune* franchise, *Avengers: Doomsday* won't have access to IMAX screens in the US for the first three weeks. Trade analysts are calling it the Barbenheimer of 2026 — except this time, both films are chasing the same audience. For Indian viewers, the math is simple: this is a double-bill weekend. Budget accordingly. ### King vs Shakti Shalini — December 24 (Christmas) And then the year's grand finale: **Shah Rukh Khan** in *King*, directed by *Pathaan* helmer **Siddharth Anand**, up against the Maddock Horror Comedy Universe entry *Shakti Shalini*, starring **Aneet Padda** and directed by *Munjya*'s **Aditya Sarpotdar**. SRK's action-thriller will dominate screens on star power alone. But after *Stree 2* earned over ₹600 crore, no one's underestimating the Maddock machine. The horror-comedy universe has proved it doesn't need a single superstar to deliver a blockbuster — it is the star. The second half of 2026 doesn't just have good films. It has *wars*. Choose your weekends wisely.
